title: Resistance penetration
wikitext:
'''Resistance penetration''' is a stat for [[hit]] damage that lowers the target's effective [[resistance]] to specific [[damage type]]s for the purpose of damage calculations. The target's actual resistance value itself is untouched.<ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/dsp3or/questions_thread_november_07_2019/f6uue0a/?context=1</ref>

==Mechanics==
When a target takes a hit with resistance penetration, that target's effective resistance is lowered for determining the amount of [[damage]] dealt by the hit. Resistance penetration does ''not'' modify the target's resistance or maximum resistance [[stat]]s, only the hit's damage calculation. 

The target's effective resistance to damage type {{math|t}} is
{{math|formula=R_t = \min( r_t, m_t ) - p_t |display=block}}
where {{math|r_t}} is the target's resistance to damage type {{math|t}}, {{math|m_t}} is the target's maximum resistance to damage type {{math|t}}, and {{math|p_t}} is the resistance penetration of the hit for damage type {{math|t}}.

Just like resistance stats, effective resistance can be a negative number. There is no minimum limit on effective resistance imposed by the game mechanics.<ref name="Penetration mechanics" /> It is not affected by the -200% cap on actual resistances.<ref>https://discord.com/channels/174993814845521922/174994219390337024/995836308863844463</ref> 

Due to the fact that resistance penetration is a property of hits, it cannot apply to [[damage over time]].<ref name="Damage over time"/>

Penetration functions ''against'' a specific resistance, not for a specific damage type. For example, chaos penetration would do nothing for {{il|Hexblast}}'s chaos damage if that chaos damage is resisted by fire resistance. Fire penetration would apply.<ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/iu8ekg/path_of_exile_heist_gem_information/g5jjkao/?context=1</ref> 

Penetration with a negative value is worded {{c|mod|Your Hits treat X Resistance as #% higher than actual value}} and raises the target's effective resistance instead. It is additive with regular penetration, and affected by the same mechanics, such as {{il|Abhorrent Interrogation}}'s {{c|mod|Your Hits cannot Penetrate}}.<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SmzvUZmicRE</ref>  

===Efficacy of resistance penetration versus resistances===
[[File:Resistance penetration efficacy.png|thumb|Efficacy of 10% resistance penetration versus resistances]]
It can be shown that resistance penetration is more effective in terms of damage dealt against targets with higher resistances.

The percentage increase to damage type {{math|formula=t}} as a result of resistance penetration is
{{math|formula=I_t = \frac{ p_t }{ 1 - \min( r_t, m_t ) }|display=block}}

==Sources of resistance penetration==
===Gems===
{{Query stat related skill gems
|type=active
|where =     skill_stats_per_level.id LIKE "base_reduce_enemy_%_resistance%"
 OR skill_stats_per_level.id LIKE "reduce_enemy_%_resistance%"
 OR skill_stats_per_level.id LIKE "%penetrate%"
 OR skill_quality_stats.id LIKE "%penetrate%"
|stat_page=penetration
}}

{{Query stat related skill gems
|type=support
|where =     skill_stats_per_level.id LIKE "base_reduce_enemy_%_resistance%"
 OR skill_stats_per_level.id LIKE "reduce_enemy_%_resistance%"
 OR skill_stats_per_level.id LIKE "%penetrate%"
 OR skill_quality_stats.id LIKE "%penetrate%"
|stat_page=penetration
}}

===Items===
====Base types====
{{Drop enabled base item table
|tables = item_stats
|join = item_stats._pageID=items._pageID
|where = 
    item_stats.id LIKE "%reduce_enemy_%_resistance%"
    OR item_stats.id LIKE "%penetration%"
|stat=1
|level=1	
}}

====Unique items====
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables = item_stats
|join = item_stats._pageID=items._pageID
|where = 
    item_stats.id LIKE "%base_reduce_enemy_%_resistance%"
    OR item_stats.id LIKE "%penetration%"
    OR item_stats.id LIKE "%penetrate%"
|large=1
|base_item=1
|level=1
|stat=1
}}

====Other items====
* {{il|Essence of Hysteria}} can add {{c|mod|Damage Penetrates 5% Elemental Resistances during any Flask Effect}} to [[belt]]s.
* [[Elder item|Elder]] [[sceptre]]s and [[wand]]s can have {{c|mod|Socketed Gems are Supported by Level (16-20) [[Fire Penetration Support|Fire Penetration]]}}.
* [[Shaper item|Shaper]] [[weapon]]s and [[amulet]]s can have {{c|mod|Damage Penetrates (4–10)% Elemental Resistances}}.
* {{il|Watcher's Eye}} can have following modifiers:
** {{c|mod|Damage Penetrates (10-15)% Fire Resistance while affected by [[Anger]]}}
** {{c|mod|Damage Penetrates (10-15)% Cold Resistance while affected by [[Hatred]]}}
** {{c|mod|Damage Penetrates (10-15)% Lightning Resistance while affected by [[Wrath]]}}

==Passive skills==
===Generic damage penetration===
{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%reduce_enemy_%_resistance_\%"
  OR passive_skill_stats.id = "base_penetrate_elemental_resistances_%"
}}

{{Query ascendancy passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%reduce_enemy_%_resistance_\%"
  OR passive_skill_stats.id = "base_penetrate_elemental_resistances_%"
}}

===Damage penetration with weapons===
{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "reduce_enemy_%_resistance_with_weapons_\%"
}}

===Other===
{{Query passive skills
|where=
  (
    passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%pene%" 
    OR passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%enemy%resist%"
  )
  AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT LIKE "%reduce_enemy_%_resistance_\%"
  AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT LIKE "reduce_enemy_%_resistance_with_weapons_\%"
  AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT IN ("base_penetrate_elemental_resistances_%")
}}
